reason: The original official CRAN MIT template has an intentional trailing space after its unfilled COPYRIGHT HOLDER field. Imported license text is preserved byte for byte; its Git whitespace check is disabled.
before_attributes:
*.R text eol=lf
*.java text eol=lf
*.py text eol=lf
*.json text eol=lf
*.md text eol=lf
licenses/*.txt -text
after_attributes:
*.R text eol=lf
*.java text eol=lf
*.py text eol=lf
*.json text eol=lf
*.md text eol=lf
licenses/*.txt -text -whitespace
